name: Picks
description: A college football pick'em for your community. Members pick a winner in every game of the open week, the board locks each game the moment its cutoff passes, and a scheduled sync brings the fixtures and the scores in from CollegeFootballData and ESPN. Leaderboards run at three scopes — this week, this season, all time — and every figure on every page says how old it is. Box scores for finished games — team statistics and the leading passer, rusher and receiver on each side — are synced a week at a time and read by anything that wants them.
author: Ernest Defoe
